events.title: An overland rigs party overlooking Salmon Glacier
events.thought: The Salmon Glacier viewpoint draws rigs from all walks of life — Waldo camped here with a collection of wanderers from around the world.
events.photoCaption: Overland rigs, campers and expedition vehicles parked for the night at the Salmon Glacier viewpoint at dusk.

events.title: Grizzly Tracks, Hannah Creek
events.thought: Fresh grizzly tracks in the mud along Hannah Creek — we weren't the only ones on this road today.
events.photoCaption: Fresh grizzly bear tracks pressed deep in the mud along Hannah Creek in the Salmon River valley, BC.

events.title: Waldo at Salmon Glacier Viewpoint
events.thought: Waldo at the Salmon Glacier viewpoint — the scale of it doesn't register until you're standing there.
events.photoCaption: Waldo parked at the Salmon Glacier summit viewpoint, the massive blue-white glacier filling the valley below.
